articles.title: Spanish Police Arrest 16-Year-Old Accused of Running KillSec Ransomware Group
articles.snippet: A second suspect faces extradition to Puerto Rico, while Investigators are tracing the proceeds of ransoms the group demanded in crypto.

articles.title: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
articles.snippet: The two proposals would define event contracts as "swaps" while excluding "casino-style gambling products"—a bid to cement the agency's exclusive jurisdiction as states sue prediction-market operators over gambling claims.
